article.title: Short art
article.excerpt: The higher the wage rate, the more valuable is time . Some people will use their greater wealth to consume more leisure, others will run around and look harried. Surely the arts should adapt to serve this second category of customer. We are all familiar with channel-surfing, or the two-minute pop song, but how about “high culture” in bite-sized portions? “
